prior_record.title: Using Bellingcat’s New Open Source Tool to Explore Historical and Spatial Flight Data
prior_record.abstract: Flight tracking data is an important tool in open source research, but with 100,000 daily flights, it can be difficult to contextualise what a particular aircraft’s movements indicate.  Bellingcat has developed a tool called Turnstone to make it easier to visualise historical trends in flight data and spot unusual patterns.
